correctness.rationale: For positive alternating gaps a,b on the real line, the infinite hat Gram operator has diagonal s/3 and off-diagonal a/6,b/6. The diagonal sign gauge makes a strictly diagonally dominant M-matrix and yields a scalar recurrence (3s^2+2ab)x_k-ab(x_{k-1}+x_{k+1})=12s delta_0. Its unique decaying Green solution x_k=C lambda^|k| and explicit odd coordinates yield an absolutely integrable sign-changing row kernel. Cell integration plus geometric sums and the recurrence's quadratic relation simplify to (5s^2+12ab)/(3s^2+4ab). Increasing u=ab/s^2 shows strict range 5/3<norm<=2, with upper equality iff a=b. Even finite-circle inverse kernels are periodizations; unequal zeros of two translated tails yield strict L1 loss at every knot, and geometric decay gives convergence. Independently inverted exact cyclic Gram matrices for (a,b)=(1,1),(1,2),(1,4),(3,7) and m=2..6; all nodal row norms agreed and were strictly below the claimed envelope. Exact envelope examples 2,69/35,173/91. The infinite assertion rests on recurrence and algebra rather than finite samples.

value.rationale: Alternating gap lengths are the canonical first nonuniform periodic mesh, and the exact L2-to-L-infinity stability constant is a fundamental numerical approximation invariant. An all-ratio closed law pinpoints balance as the unique worst contrast and proves finite periodic models are strictly more stable than their infinite envelope. This is an exact natural structural classification, not a trivial parameter substitution.

limitations: Only exactly two-periodic positive knot gaps; no arbitrary partition classification.
